parameters.url:
={{
  $node["Config"].json["SUPABASE_URL"] +
  "/rest/v1/client_feature_integrations" +
  "?select=id,client_id,feature_id,is_active,config,features!inner(slug),clients(welcome_message,default_reply,closing_message)" +
  "&" +
  (
    $node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["platform"] === "facebook"
      ? "config->>pageId=eq."
      : $node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["platform"] === "instagram"
      ? "config->>instagram_account_id=eq."
      : "config->>channelKey=eq."
  ) +
  encodeURIComponent($node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["channelKey"]) +
  "&features.slug=eq." +
  encodeURIComponent($node["Code in JavaScript1"].json["platform"]) +
  "&limit=1"
}}
